# New-ZbxCorrelation

## SYNOPSIS

Creates an event correlation.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxCorrelation [[-Name] <string>] [-Description <string>] [-Status <ZabbixCorrelationStatus>] [-Filter <ZabbixCorrelationFilterRequest>] [-Operation <ZabbixCorrelationOperationRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An event correlation closes problems when a new event matches them by tag, tag value or host group, so a recovery reported elsewhere ends them. The New-ZbxCorrelation cmdlet sends correlation.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new event correlation back with correlation.get and writes it. The server requires -Name, -Filter and -Operation; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create an event correlation

```powershell
New-ZbxCorrelation -Name 'Disaster correlation' -Filter @{ evaltype = 'AndOr'; conditions = @(New-ZbxCorrelationCondition NewEventTag -Tag 'scope') } -Operation (New-ZbxCorrelationOperation Old)
```

Creates an event correlation named Disaster correlation. The command writes the new event correlation, read back from the server.
